text: {"domains":{"block_M":[64,128],"block_N":[64,128],"block_K":[32,64],"num_stages":[1,2,3],"threads":[128]},"shared_memory_limit":49152,"weights":{"traffic":1.0,"launches":0.5,"pipeline":0.3,"footprint":0.2},"rationale":"For 2048^3 GEMM, all listed block sizes divide M,N,K, so the full nonempty domain is feasible. shared_memory_limit=49152 is the conservative max allowed here; with block_M/block_N up to 128 and block_K up to 64, the largest stage footprint is 2*64*(128+128)=32768 bytes per stage, so all tuples tie within 49152 except no pruning is needed. Objective weights emphasize traffic (dominant for tall square GEMM), moderate launches (2048/64 vs 2048/128 matters), lower pipeline and footprint to discourage excessive stages and smem. The MIP selects one tuple minimizing weighted normalized analytic features subject to the smem constraint. Any CPU-shadow correctness or latency does not establish CUDA correctness or GB10 performance; no SASS yields no timing inference, and no GPU-checked results are claimed."}
